name: application-floating-action-menu
title: Floating Action Menu
description: Floating action button components that expand into a stacked set of quick actions for common content-creation and sharing tasks.
useWhen: Floating action button components that expand into a stacked set of quick actions for common content-creation and sharing tasks.
avoidWhen: Avoid floating action menu when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Floating Action Menu uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
